falsification_conditions.condition: The asset price rises above the 200-day moving average by 10% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish trend would contradict the 'HOLD' signal and indicate a reversal of the current unknown phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volatility would invalidate the 'HOLD' by signaling a blowoff top or breakout, falsifying the current pattern's neutrality.

falsification_conditions.condition: The VIX (Volatility Index) drops below 15 for 3 consecutive days within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp decline in market fear would disprove the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by indicating a stable environment incompatible with the current hold signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
